'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Nate Muth DS Naboo: Battle Plains''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nate Muth]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Battle Plains (Dark)|Cor-D-naboobattleplains.gif|label=Naboo: Battle Plains}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Nate Dog Muth
* '''Deck name:''' TEH NOOB BEATER
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
